scope: Arithmetic from selected defaults, not a performance benchmark or observed public-network rate
assumptions: Steady homogeneous arrival rate per relay; events remain in the relevant created_at windows
Each due linear sweep completes and returns the entire retained window
Hot and warm sweeps independently run at their targets without coalescing, deferral or negotiation savings
Exclude live delivery, initial backfill, retries, overlap at page boundaries, late-created timestamps and deep re-verification
limits: 52 is a steady-state work sensitivity, not a guaranteed per-event count
Negentropy, scoped rotation and postponement change actual work; postponement changes achieved observation cadence
No claim that an alternative achieves the same detection latency at 1/52 the cost

relay_score_counterexample.result: The faster, less available relay sorts first; arithmetic demonstrates a utility choice, not measured relay behavior
